decisions.reason: A still has a dedicated page after the first round of portfolio pruning and it fits a software firm's existing strengths in location-based analytics, so management would likely keep improving it rather than remove it.

C was downgraded from a standalone page to a mere mention and sits in the more domain-specific energy-tariff space, where this firm likely has less prior knowledge and weaker absorptive capacity than in its core software capabilities.

E looks like a reusable enabling tool for regional and location-based products, so even with lower market prominence its knowledge fit and spillovers to other solutions make retention more likely than withdrawal.
